### Observed differences

- In the later window, A25 almost always leads to A27 (about 98 in 100 outgoing transitions) instead of being split roughly equally among A35, A36, A41 and A42 (about 25 each). [DIR001]
- A26's outgoing transitions now go to A35, A36, A41 and A42 (about 19–29 each) instead of almost always to A30 (about 96 in 100). [DIR002]
- A35, A36, A41 and A42 now lead to A30 (about 22–25 each) instead of to A27 (about 22–26 each). [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- A26 and A27 occur earlier in traces (mean position fell from about 0.62 to 0.51 for A26 and from 0.48 to 0.37 for A27), while A35, A36, A41 and A42 occur later (mean position rose from about 0.41 to about 0.58–0.59). [POS001–POS006]
- The order of A26 and A27 relative to A35/A36/A41/A42 reversed: before, the group preceded A26/A27 in about 98–99 in 100 cases; after, A26/A27 precede the group in about 97–99 in 100 cases. [REL001–REL008]
- A25 and A27 are now adjacent (lag 1 in about 98 in 100 cases) instead of five steps apart. [LAG001]
- A26 and A30 are no longer adjacent: they are five steps apart in all cases instead of lag 1 in about 96 in 100. [LAG004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a reordering of the process: before, the flow ran A25 → {A35, A36, A41, A42} → A27, with A26 → A30; in the later window it runs A25 → A27 and A26 → {A35, A36, A41, A42} → A30. The successor changes, the earlier positions of A26/A27 and later positions of the group, the reversed order relations, and the adjacency changes all point to the same swap. The number of qualifying items far exceeds the 0.7 expected by chance, and the signs are consistent across indicators. A competing explanation—that the difference reflects sampling variation in variant frequencies—is not fully excluded, but the magnitude and consistency of the reordering make it unlikely. Some lag items rest on very few observations in one window, but the core reordering is supported by the stronger relational and positional evidence. [DIR001–DIR006, POS001–POS006, REL001–REL008, LAG001, LAG004]
